# How the app starts the Enshrouded server (spec 5.7): its program, with no
# arguments, from its own folder; everything else is in enshrouded_server.json.
# Paths are relative to the instance's folder, games/enshrouded.

## A new world
exe: <instance>/server/enshrouded_server.exe
dir: <instance>/server
args: (none)
env: (none)
output: GameLog
log: <instance>/logs/game/enshrouded_server.log
console: no
readyWait: 10m0s
record: server Enshrouded server, port 15637, ports map[query:15637], password set true

## The same world later, renamed, on port 15700
exe: <instance>/server/enshrouded_server.exe
dir: <instance>/server
args: (none)
env: (none)
output: GameLog
log: <instance>/logs/game/enshrouded_server.log
console: no
readyWait: 5m0s
record: server Friends' Embervale, port 15700, ports map[query:15700], password set true
